name: eBay used NVIDIA V100 32GB SXM2 bare module (needs carrier + heatsink)
price_basis: USED, BARE SXM2 MODULE - no carrier, no heatsink, no PCIe edge. $500 = midpoint of the $349-800 ask band captured 2026-10-03..14. SXM2-to-PCIe adapters ~$55-205; adapter+fan bundle listings ~$840-1,140 price the adapter+labour at ~$200-340 over the bare module. ASKING price, not a sold price. PERISHABLE-FIGURE STAMP: OBSERVED 2026-10-14. RE-VERIFY BY: 2027-01-14.
lead_time_basis: lead_time_weeks is null because this is a secondary market priced per listing.
export_control_regime: EAR 3A001 or EAR99 (Volta below 3A090.a thresholds) + EAR 744.23 / 744.6 party screening
export_control_note: Volta-generation part below the 3A090.a thresholds; general EAR plus party screening applies.
notes: THE SXM2 GOTCHA IS REAL: the bare module has NO cooler and NO PCIe edge - it needs an SXM2 carrier/baseboard (OEM HGX-1 board or the now-common SXM2-to-PCIe adapter at $55-205) PLUS a heatsink. Multiple sellers ship 'V100 SXM2 + PCIe adapter + fan' bundles ~$840-1,140. 300 W part. Best value ONLY when you can source the carrier; otherwise the PCIe card (nvidia-v100-pcie-32gb, ~$695-900) is the low-drama route. Volta FP16 tensor (125 TF SXM2) means vLLM FP16 works properly.
